skin_layers.label: Foundation
skin_layers.about: Evens the skin's tone over the face and makes it more matte; in the character's own tone unless a colour is set.

skin_layers.label: Blush
skin_layers.about: Colour on the cheeks, swept up toward the temples.

skin_layers.label: Eyeshadow
skin_layers.about: Colour on the upper lids, deepest by the lashes and toward the outer corners.

skin_layers.label: Eyeliner
skin_layers.about: A line along the upper lashes with a short wing, and a fainter one under the outer lower lid.

skin_layers.label: Lip colour
skin_layers.about: Colour on the lips; lower roughness is glossier.

skin_layers.label: Brow fill
skin_layers.about: Colour on the skin under the brows, so they read fuller.

skin_layers.label: Freckles
skin_layers.about: Small brown spots where the sun falls: the nose and cheeks, shoulders, upper back and forearms. Amount shows more of them; a new seed shows others.

skin_layers.label: Moles
skin_layers.about: A few darker spots over the face and body. Amount shows more of them; a new seed shows others.

skin_layers.label: Scar
skin_layers.about: A healed scar down the left cheek: paler and smoother than the skin round it.
